h: Holiness Height and Sweetness Within the Statute of Torah

p: "This is the statute of the Torah" (Bamidbar 19:2).
at the beginning of this parsha:

for so He is called "high and lofty" (Yeshayahu 57:15),
corresponds to the attribute of Ze'ir Anpin,
that is, that it has already entered the heart,
for the attributes of Tiferes and Yesod,

פָּרָשָׁה זוֹ, חֵלֶק ג קפב, א)
and it is the Name Havayah,
for the blessing before the Torah
"When I call the Name of Hashem, etc."
that is, what is engraved in the heart;
and a chukah is without a reason;
and it corresponds to "they are exalted,"
that is, the words of Torah
that are understood by the intellect,
one senses a taste in them;
and this corresponds to "they are sweet,"
and it corresponds to the Field of Apples,
"He has not done so for any nation";
that in statutes and words of Torah
for although they fulfill the judgments,
they do not give them understanding;
(סוֹף פֶּרֶק ח מֵהִלְכוֹת מְלָכִים, הֲלָכָה יא)
because of the decision of the intellect,
this is not a ger toshav, etc.
because of the command of the Omnipresent
the inclusion of male and female";
"This is the statute of the Torah."
which is stated in the words
"This is the statute of the Torah,"
which is the attribute of Malchus,
the aspect of the Field of Apples,

paragraphs.text: Source: Bamidbar 19:2 — “זאת חקת התורה אשר צוה יהוה לאמר דבר  אל בני ישראל ויקחו אליך פרה אדמה תמימה אשר אין בה מום אשר לא עלה עליה על” — “This is the ritual law that יהוה has commanded: Instruct the Israelite people to bring you a red cow without blemish, in which there is no defect and on which no yoke has been laid.”
